verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page documents an org-level way to keep data out of AI model training, though it is arranged through an account manager. A community member's reading of the privacy statement confirms Otter discloses that recordings are used, anonymized, as training data. That corroborates the disclosure rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: any SOC 2 or HIPAA attestation in the evidence, documentation of how the opt-out is enforced or verified (it is contact-sales only), and a detailed first-party data-use policy.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture

citations.quote: Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager to get started.
After reading Otter's privacy statement, they understood that recordings are retained in the cloud and used, "anonymized," as training data.
